name: Same-sex couples in law, from the statutes cited

measures.definition: What national law offers same-sex couples: 0 sexual relations between people of the same sex are a crime, 1 legal but national law offers no union, 2 civil union or registered partnership, 3 marriage.

rights.attribution: Borgo contributors, from the statutes cited in each figure's note

vetted.notes: Legal facts with their statutes, because the indices (Equaldex, ILGA) may not be redistributed. A neutral fact: whether and which way it counts is the person's own stance.

caveats: Each figure's note says whether the law was checked against the source linked on 2026-11-05 or is stated from the law cited because that source could not be read.
The step is about forming a union at home: the note adds what it leaves out, such as EU-law recognition of a marriage concluded abroad (Poland) or local partnership certificates (Japan).
